chu_de: YEU CAU chu du an: kiem kho nguon dien dan + port tu thao tac
noi_dung: CHU DU AN YEU CAU (03/10 toi) - cloud lam: (A) CLAUDE.md da them muc 'TRINH DUYET AI + NGUON DIEN DAN DA NGON NGU' (nha da push). Cloud DOC va neu thieu thi bo sung, giu KHONG mat khau. (B) KIEM KHO he thong goc: chu du an nho > 40 nguon dien dan (moi quoc gia >= 1 dien dan, search da ngon ngu), tai khoan mang xa hoi da tao, bo tu thao tac (tu_dang_ky / tu_follow_join / seeker_theo_doi / doc_email / dang_nhap / vao_web / keywords_nguon / nguon_dien_dan). Trong repo hien chi tim thay 6 dien dan trong nguon_dien_dan.py + 26 ung vien Telegram + 29 blog trong config. Cloud tra loi MOT thu: danh sach > 40 nguon do nam o dau (file/commit/ban cu ngoai repo?), cong cu nao con chay duoc, cong cu nao cung duong dan may cu C:\Users\SV STORE, CDP 9222, IMAP email_cong_tac.json (khong co o may nay). (C) PORT: nhiem vu cloud viet: chuyen cac cong cu do sang CDP 9224 + ho so .browser_thebrain, doc ma xac minh qua Gmail thebrainago NGAY TRONG trinh duyet (khong IMAP), dang nhap bang Sign in with Google khi co; danh tinh mac dinh nam o E:\api.txt (nha doc, cloud khong thay). (D) LICH: quet lai moi nguon 1 tuan/lan, co follow; trang nhieu page (mql5 danh sach tin hieu, dien dan) doc so trang roi qua tung page, 3-5 giay/trang, luu moc 'da toi trang N'. Nha se chay theo don viec/cho khi cloud giao. Chua co viec cho nha ngay luc nay ngoai chay don cloud giao.
